policy.duplicate_handling: Exact normalized keys only; later duplicates get outcome review and are never loaded or merged until a human decides.
policy.key_normalization: Vendor code, PO number and SKU are trimmed and upper-cased; tax numbers are upper-cased and stripped of spaces and hyphens.
policy.currency_handling: Currency is explicit on every vendor and PO; accepted upper-case codes USD, EUR, GBP, INR; PO currency must equal vendor currency; no implicit default.
policy.money_rounding: Line total = ROUND_HALF_UP(quantity x unit_price, 2 dp) using fixed-point arithmetic; PO total = sum of rounded valid line totals.
policy.status_transitions: Draft -> Sent -> Received -> Closed; status_path must start at Draft, advance one step at a time and end at po_status.
policy.foreign_keys: PO.vendor must be an accepted vendor; line.po must be an accepted PO; line.sku must exist in the ERP-1 product catalogue snapshot. Held or rejected parents make the child fail with *_NOT_FOUND.
policy.date_handling: ISO YYYY-MM-DD real calendar dates only; DD/MM/YYYY-style variants are held for review as ambiguous; anything else is rejected.
policy.formula_injection_defense: OWASP formula prefixes (=, +, -, @, \t, \r) on free-text fields are rejected per PLT-12 / KIT-16.
policy.sensitive_field_masking: Bank account numbers are masked server-side and excluded from logs and exports; only the last 4 characters remain visible.
